data.long_meaning: Radhamani means 'Radiant Goddess' in Sanskrit and Hindi. This name is derived from the name of Lord Krishna's beloved, Radha. The name Radhamani carries the meaning “Radiant Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Radhamani usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
